Chapter 13's 'Population density by land type' table still has 'Hills, uplands, mountains 2–10 (5–25)'; split it into the two rows above. Cross-file report from the symbol-alignment round (decide if it applies to 13; if a chapter is cited as now using a symbol, add it to the master legend in the right group with its scale, unless it clashes; update numbers/tables to match the owner chapter): FOOD (final value in 02): c. 1300 (1300–1319) about 1,300–1,350 kcal per person per day from the main crops plus animal products, after seed, fodder, storage losses and milling or brewing losses. Grain alone about 1,200–1,250; grain rose to about 1,800 by the 1380s; about 2,000 kcal needed (Broadberry, Campbell & van Leeuwen 2011, Table 7). The baseline line 'Grain supplied only ~1,250–1,800 kcal a day after losses' under 'England c. 1300' mixes dates: 1,242 is grain in 1300/09, 1,801 is grain in 1380/89. Reword the baseline so it does not attach 1,800 to c. 1300.
